mutationFields.name: metafieldsDelete
mutationFields.description:
Deletes [`Metafield`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/current/objects/Metafield) objects in bulk by specifying combinations of owner ID, namespace, and key.

Returns the identifiers of successfully deleted metafields. If a specified metafield doesn't exist, then the mutation still succeeds but returns `null` for that identifier in the response.

args.name: metafields
args.description: A list of identifiers specifying metafields to delete. At least one identifier must be specified.

mutationFields.name: metafieldsSet
mutationFields.description:
Sets metafield values. Metafield values will be set regardless if they were previously created or not.

Allows a maximum of 25 metafields to be set at a time, with a maximum total request payload size of 10MB.

This operation is atomic, meaning no changes are persisted if an error is encountered.

As of `2024-07`, this operation supports compare-and-set functionality to better handle concurrent requests.
If `compareDigest` is set for any metafield, the mutation will only set that metafield if the persisted metafield value matches the digest used on `compareDigest`.
If the metafield doesn't exist yet, but you want to guarantee that the operation will run in a safe manner, set `compareDigest` to `null`.
The `compareDigest` value can be acquired by querying the metafield object and selecting `compareDigest` as a field.
If the `compareDigest` value does not match the digest for the persisted value, the mutation will return an error.
You can opt out of write guarantees by not sending `compareDigest` in the request.

args.name: metafields
args.description: The list of metafield values to set. Maximum of 25.

metafieldsSetInput.name: MetafieldsSetInput
metafieldsSetInput.description: The input fields for a metafield value to set.

inputFields.name: ownerId
inputFields.description: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

inputFields.name: namespace
inputFields.description:
The container for a group of metafields that the metafield is or will be associated with. Used in tandem
with `key` to lookup a metafield on a resource, preventing conflicts with other metafields with the
same `key`. If omitted the app-reserved namespace will be used.

Must be 3-255 characters long and can contain alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore characters.

inputFields.name: key
inputFields.description:
The unique identifier for a metafield within its namespace.

Must be 2-64 characters long and can contain alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore characters.

inputFields.name: value
inputFields.description: The data stored in the metafield. Always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

inputFields.name: compareDigest
inputFields.description: The `compareDigest` value obtained from a previous query. Provide this with updates to ensure the metafield is modified safely.

inputFields.name: type
inputFields.description:
The type of data that's stored in the metafield.
The type must be one of the [supported types](https://shopify.dev/apps/metafields/types).

Required when there's no corresponding definition for the given `namespace`, `key`, and
owner resource type (derived from `ownerId`).

metafieldIdentifierInput.name: MetafieldIdentifierInput
metafieldIdentifierInput.description: The input fields that identify metafields.

inputFields.name: ownerId
inputFields.description: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

metafield.name: Metafield
metafield.description:
Metafields enable you to attach additional information to a Shopify resource, such as a [Product](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/product) or a [Collection](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/collection).
For more information about where you can attach metafields refer to [HasMetafields](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/interfaces/HasMetafields).
Some examples of the data that metafields enable you to store are specifications, size charts, downloadable documents, release dates, images, or part numbers.
Metafields are identified by an owner resource, namespace, and key. and store a value along with type information for that value.

fields.name: compareDigest
fields.description: The data stored in the resource, represented as a digest.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the metafield was created.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: The metafield definition that the metafield belongs to, if any.

fields.name: jsonValue
fields.description: The data stored in the metafield in JSON format.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The unique identifier for the metafield within its namespace.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The container for a group of metafields that the metafield is associated with.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The resource that the metafield is attached to.

fields.name: ownerType
fields.description: The type of resource that the metafield is attached to.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Returns a reference object if the metafield definition's type is a resource reference.

fields.name: references
fields.description: A list of reference objects if the metafield's type is a resource reference list.

args.name: after
args.description: The elements that come after the specified [cursor](https://shopify.dev/api/usage/pagination-graphql).

args.name: before
args.description: The elements that come before the specified [cursor](https://shopify.dev/api/usage/pagination-graphql).

fields.name: type
fields.description:
The type of data that's stored in the metafield.
Refer to the list of [supported types](https://shopify.dev/apps/metafields/types).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the metafield was updated.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The data stored in the metafield. Always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.
